title: Composite contexts absent
description: The @context is not assembled from several parts: where it is written as an array, the array has at most one member. A single context in brackets is admitted, as the Declaration Format's example writes it. A context that is absent, null or empty is not judged here; USES-TROV-CORRECTLY requires one that says something.
summary: The `@context` is never composed from several parts

errorMessage.maxItems: the @context is never composed from several parts
